qx626t9t.baseName: Neo 110PCS Christmas Tree Ornaments Set - Black & White
qx626t9t.variantName: Neo 110PCS Christmas Tree Ornaments Set - Black & White
qx626t9t.sourceDescription: Transform your space into a holiday wonderland with this 110PCS Christmas Tree Ornament Set, available in four stunning color themes; Black & Gold, Red & Gold, Blue & White, and Black & White. Each set includes a balanced mix of baubles, snowflakes, leaves, pinecones, icicles, poinsettias, and a glittering tree topper star to create a cohesive and elegant Christmas tree design. Whether you prefer a modern, classic, or winter wonderland style, this ornament collection fits every holiday theme. The ornaments are crafted from durable, shatterproof plastic, offering the shine of glass without the risk of breakage, making them safe for families with children and pets. Every piece comes pre-threaded, allowing for quick and easy decorating right out of the box. Perfect not only for Christmas trees but also for holiday centerpieces, wreaths, garlands, and festive party décor. With premium finishes, varied shapes, and dazzling glitter accents, your home will shine with holiday charm. For decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Keep ornaments, hanging strings, hooks and small components out of reach of young children and pets as they may present choking, strangulation or ingestion hazards. Adult supervision is recommended when children are present. Although the ornaments are designed to be shatter-resistant, discontinue use if any item becomes cracked, broken or develops sharp edges. Take care when attaching and removing decorations from the Christmas tree and ensure all ornaments and the tree topper are securely positioned to prevent them from falling. Keep away from open flames, candles, heaters and other direct heat sources. Do not place decorations where they may obstruct walkways or create a trip hazard. Retain packaging and product information for future reference. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom

t1pzd49n.baseName: Neo 50cm Autumn Wreath with Pumpkins Berries and Sunflowers
t1pzd49n.variantName: Neo 50cm Autumn Wreath with Pumpkins Berries and Sunflowers
t1pzd49n.sourceDescription: Bring the rich colours of autumn into your home with this decorative autumn wreath, beautifully arranged with vibrant pumpkins, seasonal berries, sunflowers, foliage and a statement pumpkin-print bow. The layered design combines warm shades of orange, red, yellow and green to create a full and eye-catching seasonal display. Perfect for adding a welcoming touch to your front door, porch, hallway, fireplace or living space, this artificial wreath makes an attractive decoration throughout autumn, harvest season and Thanksgiving-inspired celebrations. With its detailed mix of faux berries, flowers, leaves and pumpkins, it offers the appearance of a traditional handcrafted arrangement without the maintenance of fresh foliage. Display it on its own as a seasonal centrepiece or coordinate it with other autumn decorations to create a warm and inviting home. •Beautiful autumn wreath - Create a warm seasonal welcome with a colourful arrangement of decorative pumpkins, berries, sunflowers, autumn leaves and foliage in rich orange, red, yellow and green tones. •Full & layered design - Generously decorated with an assortment of artificial flowers, berries, pumpkins and foliage for a full, textured appearance that adds instant autumn character to your space. •Charming pumpkin bow detail - Finished with a large decorative ribbon featuring a seasonal pumpkin and foliage print, giving the wreath an attractive statement feature and traditional harvest-inspired look. •Versatile autumn decoration - Ideal as an autumn door wreath or for decorating porches, hallways, fireplaces, walls and living spaces. A beautiful addition to harvest, Halloween and Thanksgiving-inspired décor. •Reusable seasonal display - Made with artificial decorative elements that require no watering or ongoing maintenance, allowing the wreath to be carefully stored and brought out again for future autumn seasons. •H 50 x W 50 x D 9.3cm This product is intended for decorative purposes only and is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets. Small or detachable decorative components, including berries, flowers, pumpkins, leaves and ribbon pieces, may present a choking hazard. Keep away from naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other heat or ignition sources. Ensure the wreath is securely attached when displayed on doors, walls or other surfaces to prevent it from falling. Inspect regularly and discontinue use if damaged or if any components become loose or detached. Protect from prolonged exposure to adverse weather conditions. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW

rps2h1rc.baseName: The Christmas Workshop Winter Berry Pine Christmas Wreath – 58cm
rps2h1rc.variantName: The Christmas Workshop Winter Berry Pine Christmas Wreath – 58cm
rps2h1rc.sourceDescription: Create a traditional festive welcome with this artificial pine wreath, decorated with white winter berries. Its green, white and brown tones bring a natural woodland look to your front door or an indoor Christmas display. Realistic pine sprigs give the wreath a full appearance, capturing the texture and colour of evergreen foliage without shedding needles. At approximately 58cm in diameter, it makes a distinctive focal point above a fireplace, on a wall or in a window. Suitable for indoor and outdoor display, the wreath measures approximately 14cm deep and weighs 1kg. Its durable artificial construction requires no watering or special care, so you can store it after the festivities and reuse it each Christmas. Key Features Artificial pine foliage with white winter berries for a traditional festive look. Full, natural-looking pine sprigs without needle shedding. Suitable for indoor and outdoor seasonal displays. Reusable construction includes foam, pinecone, PP and rattan. Requires no watering or special care. Approximate dimensions: H58 × W58 × D14cm; weight: 1kg. Please refer to product packaging Benross Marketing , 22 goodlass road , l24 9hj
